title: Future: be going to, Present Continuous, will
en:
be going to — plans and intentions; predictions from what we can see: I'm going to apply for a new job. Look at the sky — it's going to rain.

Present Continuous — fixed arrangements (time, place, other people): I'm meeting the auditors at 10 tomorrow.

will — decisions at the moment of speaking, offers, promises, opinions: I'll call him now. I think prices will go up.
ru: be going to — план, намерение; прогноз по признакам. Present Continuous — договорённость (время, место, люди). will — решение в момент речи, обещание, предложение помощи, мнение (I think … will).

boss.situation: Write an email to a colleague about next week: 2 plans (going to), 2 arrangements (Present Continuous) and 1 promise or offer (will).
samples: Next week I am going to finish the risk register.
I'm also going to update our procedures.
On Monday I'm meeting the auditors at 10.
On Wednesday we're having a call with head office.
Don't worry, I'll send you the agenda today.

qs.q: Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
I ___ the dentist at 4 tomorrow. It's booked.
The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.
Next year we ___ open a new office. That's the plan.
I think the meeting ___ long.
Don't worry, I ___ tell anyone.
What ___ you doing this weekend?
qs.ru: Планы на выходные — are you doing.

qs.q: That bag looks heavy. I ___ help you.
“I'm meeting Ali at six” is about a fixed arrangement.
“I will see the doctor at 3 tomorrow, I booked it last week” is the best choice.
qs.exp: Booked arrangement → I'm seeing the doctor at 3.

qs.q: We ___ (have) a meeting with the director on Friday. It's in the calendar.
a: are having

qs.q: I'm tired. I think I ___ (go) to bed.
a: will go

qs.q: She ___ (study) English next year. She has decided.
a: is going to study

qs.q: Be careful! You ___ (fall)!
a: are going to fall

qs.q: I promise I ___ (not / be) late again.
a: won't be
will not be

qs.q: Where ___ you going to stay in Almaty?
a: are

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i am going to apply for a new job

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we are meeting the auditors on monday

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i think it will be a difficult year

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what are you going to do after work

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she is flying to london next week

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i will send you the file tonight

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I going to call him.”
a: I'm going to call him.
I am going to call him.
qs.exp: Need am: I am going to.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “It will rain — look at the black clouds!”
a: It's going to rain — look at the black clouds!
It is going to rain — look at the black clouds!
It's going to rain. Look at the black clouds!
It is going to rain. Look at the black clouds!

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I meet my manager tomorrow at ten.”
a: I'm meeting my manager tomorrow at ten.
I am meeting my manager tomorrow at ten.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am helping you with that box.”
a: I'll help you with that box.
I will help you with that box.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Are you go to come to the party?”
a: Are you going to come to the party?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I think she is winning the election next year.”
a: I think she will win the election next year.
I think she'll win the election next year.

qs.q: Я собираюсь найти новую работу.
a: I'm going to find a new job.
I am going to find a new job.
I am going to look for a new job.
I'm going to look for a new job.

qs.q: Завтра в десять я встречаюсь с аудиторами.
a: Tomorrow at ten I'm meeting the auditors.
Tomorrow at ten I am meeting the auditors.
I'm meeting the auditors tomorrow at ten.
I am meeting the auditors tomorrow at ten.
I'm meeting the auditors at ten tomorrow.
I am meeting the auditors at ten tomorrow.

qs.q: Я помогу тебе.
a: I'll help you.
I will help you.

qs.q: Я думаю, это будет трудный год.
a: I think it will be a difficult year.
I think it will be a hard year.
I think this will be a difficult year.
I think this will be a hard year.

qs.q: Что ты делаешь в эти выходные?
a: What are you doing this weekend?
What are you going to do this weekend?

qs.q: Смотри, сейчас пойдёт дождь.
a: Look, it's going to rain.
Look, it is going to rain.
Look! It's going to rain.
Look! It is going to rain.

qs.q: Обещаю, я не опоздаю.
a: I promise I won't be late.
I promise I will not be late.
I promise, I won't be late.

qs.q: В пятницу мы летим в Астану.
a: On Friday we are flying to Astana.
On Friday we're flying to Astana.
We are flying to Astana on Friday.
We're flying to Astana on Friday.
